# iru_custom_scripts (Data Source)

Look up Iru custom scripts, optionally filtered by name. Use the returned `id` for `library_item_id` on assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_custom_scripts" "hello" {
  name = "Hello"
}

# Reference the matching ID:
#   one(data.iru_custom_scripts.hello.results).id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) If set, only custom scripts whose name exactly matches are returned.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching custom scripts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the script is active.
- `execution_frequency` (String) How often the script runs.
- `id` (String) Library item ID.
- `name` (String) Script name.
